title: Complete Organizational Graph Schema
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Organizational Analytics
description: Interactive meta-model of the complete organizational graph schema: ten node types and thirteen edge types. Hovering highlights connected edge types, clicking a node type shows a sample Cypher CREATE statement, and a question picker highlights the schema elements needed to answer an analytics question.

learningObjectives: Assess the complete organizational graph schema, evaluating how each node type and edge type contributes to organizational analytics capability
prerequisites: Node types and edge types of the organizational model
Reading Cypher CREATE and MATCH patterns

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Schema exploration followed by question-driven evaluation
keyQuestions: Which node type is the hub of the model, and why?
Which schema elements does each analytics question need?
Which elements would you build first, and which would you defer?
commonMisconceptions: A schema diagram shows individual employees rather than types
Every analytics question needs the whole schema
assessmentOpportunities: List the minimum node types and edge types needed for a chosen question
Justify leaving one element out of an initial model
